source: https://www.sharewillow.com/ stylesheet @layer theme :root, :host, read live in the T3 preview browser on 2026-11-19. Marketing site only. The app at app.sharewillow.com declares a separate HSL token set; see raw/login.json.

viewport.note: A freeform 1440x900 request settled at innerWidth 1440 and innerHeight 900 on the pricing navigation. The first home read, before resize, was innerWidth 1169, innerHeight 731, devicePixelRatio 2.

theme: light only. No prefers-color-scheme dark rule and no .dark class on the marketing stylesheets. html class was 'h-full antialiased js-anim'. color-scheme computed as normal.

display.text-display-2xl: font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.035em; font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 9vw, 7.5rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 0.95
display.text-display-xl: font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 5rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1
display.text-display-lg: font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.25rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.05
display.text-display-band: font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.028em; font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 4.6vw, 3.75rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.04
display.text-display-hero-split: font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.25rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.02
display.text-display-md: font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 2.5vw, 2.25rem); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.1

motion.hero-in: 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); keyframes 0% opacity 0 translateY(14px), 100% opacity 1 translateY(0). Removed under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (animation: auto ease 0s none).
motion.button: transform, background, color, border 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); active:scale-[0.985]
motion.reducedMotion: Marketing honours prefers-reduced-motion: reduce for html.js-anim .hero-in, .start-in, .bg-aurora, [class^=sc-], .orb-pulse. html scroll-behavior is smooth only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

screenshots: preview_snapshot returned 'The browser is not producing screenshot frames' twice. No PNG was saved. Do not invent one.
